_readme: Knobs for Phase A (eval-side duration binning on a 4_finetune_text matrix run).
- fixed    : use bins_audio_sec / bins_text_words as literal boundaries.
- quantile : derive 5 equal-count bins from the test source's own distribution.
Sanity cross-check: real structure survives the switch; artefacts don't.
test_source_axis: which x-axis to use for each test source.
- audio_sec   : bin by (end_t - start_t) from the source JSONL.
Phase A: ROG uses audio_sec (metadata available) and text_words side-by-side;
ParlaSent-SL uses text_words only (text source); ParlaSpeech-SI uses text_words
as a fallback until data/parlaspeech_v4_si_utterance_instance.jsonl is re-exposed.
min_bin_n: bins with fewer items are kept in the long CSV but omitted from the
primary envelope plot (too noisy to draw a line through).
self_labeled_backbone: cells where this backbone trained on any mixture with 'P' are
flagged. They reproduce the ParlaSent-model's own labels on ParlaSpeech and measure
self-consistency, not transfer; excluded from the primary envelope curve.

languages_registry._note: For Phase B — not consumed by Phase A scripts. Each entry names the parlasent_<lang> and parlaspeech_<lang> JSONLs we expect under data/.
